method: Fit floor planes in recorded input; rotate into original trajectory world. Apply the constant transform fitted by native backend to the initial 12s replay. Residual full-walk tilt is evaluated by applying this same transform to original normals; full walk not rerun. Separately compare enabled/disabled native 12s replays pointwise and at matching timestamps.
limitations: Floor must be horizontal and visible at initialization; plane selection can fail or select the wrong surface.
Constant output transform does not correct estimator drift.
No ground truth trajectory accuracy or loop closure.
